definitions.explanation: A prize offered in a contest, quiz or lottery-style draw, or the competition itself.

examples.japanese: {懸賞|けんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{懸賞|けんしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won a trip in a sweepstakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{懸賞|けんしょう}⟦クイズ→クイズ：10804_kuizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧、⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my answers to the magazine's prize quiz and sent them in on a postcard.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {懸賞|けんしょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enter a prize competition
- {懸賞|けんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: to win a prize
- ⟦{懸賞金|けんしょうきん}→懸賞金：22330_kenshoukin⟧: prize money; a reward or bounty (⟦{懸賞金|けんしょうきん}→懸賞金：22330_kenshoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける, to offer a reward)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- In sumo, {懸賞|けんしょう} is the sponsors' prize money for a bout; their banners are carried round the ring before it, and the winner receives the envelopes.

WATCH OUT:
- Same reading as ⟦{検証|けんしょう}→検証：04792_kenshou⟧ (verification) and ⟦{健勝|けんしょう}→健勝：33056_kenshou⟧ (good health, in letters).
